title: REV-ERBα regulates photoreceptor metabolism and visual function and protects against inherited retinal degeneration
title_zh: REV-ERBα调节感光细胞代谢和视功能并保护 against inherited retinal degeneration
abstract: Abstract The retina is a metabolically demanding tissue essential for visual function. Disruptions in retinal metabolic pathways are linked to degenerative eye diseases like retinitis pigmentosa (RP). In this study, we found that REV-ERBα ( Nr1d1 ), a nuclear receptor central to mitochondrial biogenesis, is critical for retinal metabolism, visual function, and protects against retinal degeneration. Expression of REV-ERBα is present throughout retinal cells, with high levels in photoreceptors. Both systemic genetic deletion and rod photoreceptor specific deletion of REV-ERBα in mice resulted in dampened visual function with reduced amplitude of a- and b-waves in the electroretinogram. REV-ERBα-deficient retinas and photoreceptor cells exhibited impaired mitochondrial function with decreased oxygen consumption and altered expression of metabolic genes. Importantly, activation of REV-ERBα with a synthetic agonist SR9009 substantially delayed photoreceptor loss in an rd10 genetic mouse model of RP, with slower retinal thinning, reduced levels of photoreceptor apoptosis, and partially preserved visual function. Together, our findings position REV-ERBα as a critical regulator of retinal and photoreceptor metabolism and function, and a promising therapeutic target for addressing retinal degeneration. Modulating REV-ERBα activity may offer a novel strategy for protecting retinal neurons and mitigating vision loss in eye diseases like RP.
abstract_zh: 摘要：视网膜是一种代谢需求极高的组织，对视功能至关重要。视网膜代谢途径的紊乱与视网膜退行性疾病（如视网膜色素变性）密切相关。在本研究中，我们发现REV-ERBα（Nr1d1），一种位于线粒体生物合成中心的核受体，对视网膜代谢、视功能以及保护视网膜退行至关重要。REV-ERBα在视网膜细胞中广泛表达，感光细胞水平较高。小鼠全身性基因敲除以及感光细胞特异性敲除REV-ERBα均导致视功能迟钝，电生理图中a-波和b-波幅度降低。REV-ERBα缺失的视网膜和感光细胞线粒体功能受损，氧气消耗减少，代谢基因表达改变。重要的是，使用合成激动剂SR9009激活REV-ERBα在视网膜色素变性遗传小鼠模型（rd10）中显著延迟感光细胞丢失，表现为视网膜薄化速度减慢、感光细胞凋亡水平降低，视功能部分保存。综上，我们的研究定位REV-ERBα作为视网膜和感光细胞代谢和功能的关键调节因子，以及治疗视网膜退行的有前景的治疗靶点。调节REV-ERBα活性可能为保护视网膜神经元和缓解视网膜疾病（如RP）相关视力损失提供一种新策略。
